title: Guide to Infection Prevention for Outpatient Settings: Minimum Expectations for Safe Care | HAIs | CDC
content: Guide to Infection Prevention for Outpatient Settings: Minimum Expectations for Safe Care Sept. 30, 2025 At a glance Infection prevention recommendations for outpatient (ambulatory care) settings based primarily upon elements of Standard Precautions and represents the minimum infection prevention expectations for safe care in ambulatory care settings. These recommendations reflect existing evidence-based guidelines produced by CDC and the Healthcare Infection Control Practices Advisory Committee.
